text:
Alex: Heads up — after yesterday's routing policy rollout I'm seeing small invoice deltas for a subset of tenants (mostly high-concurrency API clients). Preview invoices show ~0.4-1% fewer tokens than final invoices for some windows. Not catastrophic but customers will notice. Anyone else?
Priya: Yup, spotted similar. Looks like some events are landing just outside our compact agg window when we have short bursts + route fallback. Pulled logs: 
```
metering.events: {tenant: T123, tokens: 234, ts: 2025-03-08T14:02:59Z, route: fallback}
metering.agg: window_end: 2025-03-08T14:03:00Z, counted_tokens: 0 for T123
```
That's why preview (which queries agg table) misses them but invoice re-aggregator picks them up later. :grimacing:
Mateo: My hunch: aggregator uses epoch-aligned compact windows (30s) but the edge service emits session-end events slightly after expiry when route fallback retries. So events fall into the next micro-window and the preview query that snapshots current agg table misses them. We saw this in dev once but assumed rare.
Alex: So options: 1) expand agg window / add jitter tolerance, 2) move preview to query raw stream + coalescing logic, or 3) make emitter idempotent + re-emit with deterministic keys so re-aggregation is trivial. Thoughts?
Jordan: UX wise we can reduce customer surprise by showing "provisional" vs "settled" tokens in Console billing preview. Provisional shows current agg snapshot; settled shows last finalized invoice. Tooltip: "Provisional numbers may change due to late-arriving events." Yellow badge + link to explain settlement lag.
Priya: Quick mitigation I'd prefer: add a small post-agg reconciliation job that runs every minute to pull late events from the raw topic and apply into agg table with idempotent upserts. Minimal blast radius, no user-visible schema changes. We should also add an event flag when fallback path used so we can track correlation.
billing-bot: ALERT: invoice-delta-spike detected for prod (since 2025-03-08T14:00Z). Delta rate: 0.8% across sampled tenants. Ticket created: #BILL-4721.
Mateo: Proposed rollout plan: implement reconciliation job + metrics, dogfood on staging, enable feature flag metering.reconcile_v1 for 5% tenants, monitor for 24h, then 100%. Feature flag naming: `metering.reconcile.windowed_v1`. Canary command (local test): 
```bash
kafkacat -b kafka:9092 -t metering.events -o -100 | jq '. | select(.tenant=="T_CANARY")'
```
Alex: What telemetry do we need to be confident? I want: duplicate_event_count, settlement_latency_p95, preview_vs_final_skew_rate (per-tenant), reconciliation_applied_count, and error_rate for reconciliation job. Set alert if preview_vs_final_skew_rate > 0.5% for >10 tenants over 1h.
Priya: I'll own the PR for reconciliation job + add `fallback_used` attribute to events. Also will wire dashboards: one panel for skew rate heatmap, one for reconciliation throughput, and a simple table of affected tenants. ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial PR.
Jordan: I'll draft a Console copy for provisional/settled UI and add the badge mock. Need product review from @sales-ops before rollout so revenue ops isn't surprised.
Alex: Cool — action items: 
- Priya: PR for reconciliation job + telemetry + event flag (#BILL-4721)
- Mateo: add feature flag + canary script, coordinate staging dogfood
- Jordan: Console provisional/settled UI copy & mock, coordinate with Sales Ops
- Alex: set alert thresholds and own rollout checklist
We'll triage impact via the new skew-rate dashboard. Ping here when PR is ready. :thumbsup:
